_note: Data source for the Slate Feed page (/slate-feed). The feed is designed to aggregate activity from EVERY member's slate — each item carries an 'author' key pointing into 'authors' below, so when other people's profiles exist their events drop into this same file (or the database that replaces it) and appear in the feed automatically. Today the only profile on the platform is Pete's, so every item is pulled from his Slate Board (templates/slate_board.html): same titles, same dates, same progress numbers, and every link lands on the real card it came from. app.py's load_slate_feed() reads this file, sorts items newest-first, and computes the live '2h ago' style labels and the current week range.
